name: Agency hero: type a business name and a live search result plus site preview assemble themselves from it
notes: Signature effect: the visitor types their business name and the panel builds a plausible Google result plus a miniature site card from it, in reading order. The generator is the interesting part: SKIP drops articles so 'The Oak Cliff Bakery' monograms as OC rather than TO, and the domain builder trims to the first two meaningful words once a slug passes 26 characters so long names do not produce an absurd URL. Everything runs in the browser and nothing is sent anywhere, which the copy says out loud because that is the trust argument. The result region is aria-live so a screen reader hears it change instead of missing the entire point. Staged reveal is authored per element via data-step rather than one blanket fade, and a forced reflow between removing and re-adding .on is what makes a retype actually replay. Grid is two columns and two rows so mobile collapses to say, then stage, then actions: you type, you see the result, then you decide. Part of the ten hero 940Digital brand series (sections 0027 to 0036); the series log, the contact sheet that renders all ten live, and the written recommendation are in brand-heroes/set-evidence/. Unlike the client-derived sections in this library, this one is NOT de-identified: 940Digital is Owen's own business, so there is no third party to protect and the real wordmark, palette and copy are the point of the section. Brand rules baked in across the whole series: display type at weight 500 with about -0.03em tracking (not 700); #3194E0 never carries text on a light background because it measures 2.90:1, so blue text on sand is #1F6FB0 and a blue fill takes a charcoal label at 5.18:1; every figure is JetBrains Mono with tabular-nums; text containers are sized in ch, not px.
